source: local game 1.5.3 GameAssembly.dll native disassembly + bh2 ability data (read-only)

blackHoleReducedCooldown.meaning: Recurrence node (property 70) cooldown reduction for Black Hole

getChargeRegen_override.method: BlackHoleMutator.getChargeRegen (RVA 0x2408400 override native at RVA 0x1831320 / file offset 0x182fd20)
getChargeRegen_override.behavior: base = AbilityMutator.getChargeRegen() (ability.chargesGainedPerSecond + addedChargeRegen = 1/14 s); if statsManager.blackHoleReducedCooldown != 0: rate = safeQuotient(1 - reducedCooldown) then rate = base / (1 - reducedCooldown)
getChargeRegen_override.implication: Recurrence (property 70, 4 points = 60%) reduces charge-regen cooldown multiplicatively as (1 - CDR): base recharge 14s -> 14*(1-0.6)=5.6s before any ICR/added-cooldown interactions. v1 currently puts Recurrence 60% into the ICR additive pool: (14+2)/(1+1.3575)=6.787s -> likely wrong; exact ICR/added-cooldown integration still to confirm.

charge_manager.RefreshChargeInfo: computes chargeRegen = 1.0 / cooldown when cooldown > 0 (cooldown from ability/stats query); exact stat query symbol not yet resolved

node_effects.Recurrence: property 70 Cooldown Reduction +15%/point (4 pts=60%), mapped to blackHoleReducedCooldown
node_effects.Endless Maw: duration +30%/point + cooldown +2s/point (accumulator; applied through added cooldown length path)

open: exact cooldown formula: how base 14s, added cooldown +2s, Recurrence CDR (1-CDR), and gear ICR combine; candidate recharges 5.6s vs 6.787s vs 3.18s (order matters)
Binary System +100% more stat stacking with structural two-component copy and Ignite inheritance (high impact)

getCooldown_method.note: AbilityMutator.GetCooldown(Stats, bool ignoreStats) (RVA 0x2405960) uses virtual getters for base cooldown, added cooldown length, increased cooldown recovery speed, more cooldown recovery speed, and a minimum-cooldown clamp; final result returned as 1/rate with max(minCooldown, ...) logic. Exact register-level mapping not yet finished.
getCooldown_method.impact: loop DPS scales ~inversely with recharge; spread 3.19-6.79s means large potential difference vs v1, must not update ruleset until formula is pinned or validated in game.
